records.label: Chunk 01 detailed evidence: People and factions

facts.text: **Tamello De Fformelo Tussock / Tammo**, young hare imagining Long Patrol captaincy, wants service but is judged too young by father (4–42). **Lynum**, older brother, **Saithe**, older sister, both prefer farming despite eligible age; species doesn't mandate soldier role (9–40). **Colonel Cornspurrey De Fformelo Tussock / Corney**, retired father, one closed eye, polished-crystal monocle, decorated buff campaign jacket, brown-bark forage helmet, pace stick, old battle-ax; former **Fifty-first Paw'n'fur Platoon of the Long Patrol** (18–40). **Mem Divinia**, mother, capable cook and household authority, arranges son's departure to prevent repeating father/grandfather estrangement (27–51). **Osmunda**, molewife cook/helper, husband **Roolee** messenger (45–50,98). **Russa Nodrey**, lean red female squirrel, independent wandering fighter with uncertain origin (south or west rumor), no family/tribe/home; knowledgeable navigator, light traveler, speaks mole dialect fluently (90–113). **Whinn**, young hedgehog singer139–156. **Gormad Tunn**, dying Greatrat Firstblade, sons **Damug Warfang** and **Byral Fleetclaw**, succession duel aided by **Lugworm**, stoat saboteur; Gormad dies, Byral killed, Damug becomes Firstblade53–89. Greatrats described twice ordinary rat size, narrative taxonomy not game scale. **Cregga Rose Eyes**, female Badger Lord, Bloodwrath reputation and enormous pike reported by Russa129–131; report not calibrated equipment load. Rapscallions contrasted with searats/corsairs but not limited to coastline despite residents' claims124–134.

records.label: Chunk 01 detailed evidence: Places and maps

facts.text: **Far east lands** melt from winter into spring; cliff-ledged stream through fir/pine groves toward broad plains/coast (3). **Camp Tussock** in largest conifer grove, log stockade enclosing rock/timber/moss/mud-chinked rambling **Barracks**17; communal **dormitory cellar beneath stockade**173 supports built-into-ground dwelling reference. Cliff resting nook near camp, wind-protected streamside96. Rapscallion wreck fleet/hovels of flotsam/dunnage several leagues down **far southeast coast**, shingle/tide line/death tent/duel ring52–89. **Salamandastron** western badger mountain/Long Patrol headquarters, current ruler Cregga, damaged coast nearby storm report120–129. **Redwall Abbey** offered intermediate destination with regular Patrol visits164. Distinguish reported west cliff collapse from observed east/southeast camp. **Dark Forest** afterlife destination in succession language54–70, not mapped terrestrial grove.

records.label: Chunk 01 detailed evidence: Food, ingredients, recipes and methods

facts.text: **Barley scones** on griddle27, hollowed tops filled honey48; **honeyed barleyscones** later118 same variant. **Carrot, mushroom and onion hotpot** golden crust with young mint added47. Fuller **Tussock hotpot**115: earthenware basin, piecrust, corn/carrot/mushroom/turnip/winter cabbage/onion, rich gravy with unnamed secret herbs. Preserve shorter observation + fuller signature recipe; mint is observed early garnish, other herbs unspecified. **Mem's pancakes**49 explicit greensap milk, hazelnut and almond flour; grammar can mean hazelnut flour plus almond flour, label ambiguity. Thirty pancakes travel payment180 source count not balanced yield. **Early-spring vegetable soup**, **flat crisp oatmeal bannocks**115. **Apple, blackberry and plum crumble**, **Osmunda's greensap and maple sauce**, **hot mint and comfrey tea**, **horse-chestnut beer**, **red-currant cordial**, **white hazelnut cheese**, **elderflower bread**118. Comfrey/horse-chestnut source references require clearly renamed game alternatives, not real edible endorsement. Cheese base unspecified; don't call dairy canon from name alone. Greensap explicitly plant-style milk vocabulary useful established series alternative. Raw snow Tammo eats8 is behavior not prepared recipe. Swear vinegar30, hypothetical apple-size rock76 and figurative stag/etc not meals.

records.label: Chunk 01 detailed evidence: Customs, style, feelings and themes

facts.text: Family affection entwines military pride, controlling parent and private care; mother challenges harsh speech and fears inherited estrangement47. Military bluster is comic but not consequence-free; Tammo tears and mother's tear into batter matter. Shared meal, song/recitation/dance/reed flutes/small drums156; no lyrics copied. Russa news-telling gives geographic context naturally over food, interrupts rigid class hierarchy. Meal negotiation persuades independent guide, not automatic recruit purchase. Rapscallion fasting/death vigil, hereditary Greatrat qualification, duel and wagers establish faction succession model61–89; sabotage undermines claimed legitimacy. Book One **The Runaway Recruit**1–2.
